free_text: A repeat biopsy is indicated because the evidence converged on proceeding with further investigation, driven by the rising PSA trend (from 6.8 to 7.3 ng/mL) and the high-risk PI-RADS 5 finding on the MRI. Although the prior biopsy showed ISUP group 2 disease, the combination of a rising PSA and a high-risk MRI finding necessitates a confirmatory biopsy to guide further management. The evidence converged on a need for further investigation.
